subject: Aligning SKU-level packaging with PO constraints and net-term discount triggers
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@hearthwell.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.reynolds@hearthwell.com
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood packaging + PO requirements — need to lock discount eligibility

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the last call. Procurement reviewed the draft commercial and we have two things blocking internal approval: SKU-level packaging on invoices (Hearthwell uses line-item mapping to our ERP) and how PO references determine discount eligibility. Short summary of our asks: 

- We need the PO number to appear on every invoice line (not just header) so our AP system can match SKU bundles to GL codes.
- Hearthwell wants to split a single purchase across multiple PO lines (finance requirement) — can Redwood accept multiple PO lines referencing the same subscription agreement and still apply a single discount threshold?
- We typically work Net30 but can accept Net45 for strategic vendors; however our discount thresholds (e.g., early-payment or volume-tier discounts) are tied to invoice cadence. Can you confirm which net-term your billing system will apply and whether discounts can be conditioned on "monthly invoicing + PO number present"?

I attached the PO spec we mapped from our ERP (HW_PO_Specs.pdf). If Redwood can confirm the technical invoice fields and what you need from us (PO placement, required attributes, any EDI templates), we can push this through legal + AP.

Can we target sign-off by EOD next Thursday (2026-10-15)? Happy to schedule a quick mapping call with my AP lead (Tom) if helpful.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement | Hearthwell Medical
Samantha.Lee@hearthwell.com
+1 412-555-0198

Attachments: HW_PO_Specs.pdf (PDF, 84KB)

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@hearthwell.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@hearthwell.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood packaging + PO requirements — need to lock discount eligibility

Hi Samantha — appreciate the clear note and the PO spec. Short answer: yes, we can support the principal asks, with a couple of operational requirements. High level:

- Invoice fields: we can put the PO number on every invoice line (we call the field PO_NUMBER) — that maps cleanly to your line-item matching.
- Multiple PO lines: we can accept multiple POs referencing the same Redwood agreement. We will apply discounts at the subscription level provided the POs are linked in our system to the same account and include the agreed Commitment ID. If POs are split across different legal entities, discounts will need entity-level mapping (we can walk this during the mapping call).
- Net terms & discount gating: our standard hosted billing is Net45. We can offer Net30 for this deal if AP requires it, but the discount structure we discussed (volume tier + early payment) has two triggers: (a) committed ARR threshold on the mutual action plan, and (b) invoice cadence (monthly invoices with PO_NUMBER present). We can implement a conditional discount rule that requires both.

I've attached our SKU packaging matrix (Redwood_SKU_packaging_matrix.xlsx) which shows SKU-to-line mappings and how we would place PO_NUMBER. To move quickly, propose:
1) Quick mapping call with Tom + your AP lead to confirm PO_NUMBER placement and whether the POs will be consolidated into a single accounting entity (30 min).
2) Redwood to send a short amendment template that documents: accepted PO formats, the committed ARR that unlocks the discount, and the invoice cadence requirement.
3) We sign amendment and AP runs a test invoice.

If it's helpful I can loop in Kimberly from Finance to confirm the amendment language. Do you want that on the call tomorrow?

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_SKU_packaging_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB)

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-10-05T13:00:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Hearthwell PO mapping — need sign-off on amendment language

Vanessa / Kimberly — forwarding Hearthwell's PO spec and my reply below. They need confirmation that we can: (1) accept multiple PO lines tied to same agreement while preserving a single discount calculation, (2) require PO_NUMBER per invoice line, (3) make discount conditional on monthly invoices + committed ARR.

Draft proposed language (short):
- "Customer must include PO_NUMBER on each invoice line; Redwood will apply discounts only when invoices are issued monthly and the total committed ARR (per Mutual Action Plan ID) meets the agreed tier."
- "Multiple PO lines referencing the same Redwood agreement are allowed provided Customer maps all PO numbers to the same Redwood billing entity; discounts will not span multiple legal entities without explicit amendment."

Kimberly — can Finance/Legal sign this as a 1-page commercial attachment? If yes, I'll send the formal amendment to Samantha and schedule the AP mapping call. Vanessa — if we require committed ARR >= $250k to unlock the 8% tier, is that consistent with our commercial offer?

Thanks —
Ben

Date: 2026-10-05T13:32:00-07:00
Subject: RE: FW: Hearthwell PO mapping — need sign-off on amendment language

Ben / Vanessa — quick confirmation from Finance/Legal side:

- We can require PO_NUMBER on every invoice line. Please instruct the customer to use the exact key 'PO_NUMBER' in their ERP export so our ingestion maps cleanly.
- Discounts: Finance needs the committed ARR to be documented on the Mutual Action Plan (MAP ID). Recommend minimum threshold of $250,000 ARR for the 8% volume tier. For early-payment incentive (1.5%), we'll offer that as a separate credit applied if Hearthwell pays within 10 days and provides remittance reference to the invoice line PO_NUMBER.
- Net terms: default is Net45. We can make Net30 official for this customer via the amendment, but note Net30 removes the early-payment incentive (too many accounting exceptions).

I've attached a short PO_alignment_memo.docx that Legal can use as the attachment to the order form; it includes the field-level requirements and sample invoice layout. Once Ben gets customer confirmation on entity mapping (single billing entity + POs linked), Legal can sign.

Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations & Finance
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Attachments: PO_alignment_memo.docx (DOCX, 16KB)
